title: Saucer as contractor-owned prototype with umbilicals
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Saucer as contractor-owned prototype with umbilicals, about 1992 at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: I believe it was probably owned by a defense contractor and was not part of the US Air Force inventory.

plain: Greg Rogers, who describes himself as a NASA doctor, says that in 1992 he saw a saucer-shaped craft in a secret hangar at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida, hooked up to cables and hoses. He says he believes it was probably owned by a defense contractor, a private company building for the military, and was not part of the US Air Force's own fleet. If true, it would mean private companies hold saucer-shaped craft out of public view.
